title: EMS Diagnostics Configuration
description: Thresholds, intervals, and enable flags for the diagnostics module. Controls SOH trending, PCS efficiency, thermal analysis, comm health scoring, and predictive alerts.

_schema_version.description: Schema version for migration detection. Must match the expected schema version.

intervals.description: Timing intervals controlling how frequently the diagnostics module publishes results and recomputes trend metrics.

publish_s.description: Interval in seconds between ZMQ PUB publications of current diagnostic results. Lower values increase CPU and network load.

trend_update_s.description: Interval in seconds between DuckDB historical trend recalculations. Trend queries are sub-second but update infrequently to avoid redundant work.

thresholds.description: Threshold values that trigger diagnostic warnings or critical alerts. Adjust per site to match battery type and operational requirements.

soh_warning_pct.description: State-of-health percentage below which a SOH warning alert is raised. Typical LFP field threshold: 85%.

soh_critical_pct.description: State-of-health percentage below which a critical alert is raised and predictive maintenance is recommended. Typical: 80%.

pcs_efficiency_warning_pct.description: PCS round-trip efficiency percentage below which a warning is raised. Values below 90% suggest inverter degradation.

thermal_delta_warning_c.description: Temperature delta (cell max minus ambient) in degrees Celsius above which a thermal warning is raised. Excessive delta indicates cooling degradation.

comm_fault_warning_rate.description: Number of communication faults per hour above which a comm health warning is raised. Faults include CAN timeouts, Modbus CRC errors, and missed polls.

prediction.description: Parameters controlling the linear regression predictive alert algorithm. Predictions require a minimum history window to be statistically meaningful.

min_history_days.description: Minimum days of SOH data that must exist before any prediction is computed. Prevents noise-driven predictions on new installations.

history_window_days.description: Number of days of historical SOH data used as input to the linear regression slope. Longer windows are more stable; shorter windows detect recent degradation changes faster.

battery.description: Battery physical parameters for the installed system. Must be set per-installation to match the actual hardware.

rated_capacity_ah.description: Nominal cell (or rack) capacity in ampere-hours at rated conditions. Used as the denominator in coulomb-counting SOH estimation.

metrics.description: Enable or disable individual diagnostic categories. Disable categories where hardware is not present (e.g. thermal_enabled: false on sites without BTMS).

soh_enabled.description: Enable SOH estimation using coulomb counting. Requires BMS rack telemetry (pack_i, pack_soc).

pcs_efficiency_enabled.description: Enable PCS efficiency calculation. Requires PCS telemetry (ac_power, dc_power).

thermal_enabled.description: Enable thermal delta analysis. Requires BTMS telemetry (outlet_temp) and BMS cell temperatures.

comm_health_enabled.description: Enable communication fault rate tracking. Requires alarm_pub comm_fault events.

predictions_enabled.description: Enable predictive alerts using linear regression on historical SOH trends. Requires min_history_days of data.
